items.source: Create a new RequestHandledEvent with session information.
items.translation: 创建一个新的包含会话信息的 RequestHandledEvent。

items.source:
Supported by Spring's own FrameworkServlet (through a specific
ServletRequestHandledEvent subclass), but can also be raised by any
other web component.
items.translation: 由 Spring 自身的 FrameworkServlet（通过特定的 ServletRequestHandledEvent 子类）支持，但也可能由任何其他 Web 组件引发。

items.source:
Return a full description of this event, involving
all available context data.
items.translation: 返回此事件的完整描述，包含所有可用的上下文数据。

items.source: Return the cause of failure, if any.
items.translation: 如有失败原因，请返回该原因。

items.source: Return the processing time of the request in milliseconds.
items.translation: 返回请求的处理时间（毫秒）。

items.source: Return the id of the HTTP session, if any.
items.translation: 返回 HTTP 会话的 ID（如果有）。

items.source:
Return a short description of this event, only involving
the most important context data.
items.translation: 返回此事件的简短描述，仅包含最重要的上下文数据。

items.source:
Return the name of the user that was associated with the request
(usually the UserPrincipal).
items.translation: 返回与请求关联的用户名称（通常是 UserPrincipal）。

items.source:
• ServletRequestHandledEvent
  • FrameworkServlet
  • ApplicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(ApplicationEvent)
  • Serialized Form
items.translation:
• ServletRequestHandledEvent
  • FrameworkServlet
  • ApplicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(ApplicationEvent)
  • Serialized Form

items.source: source - the component that published the event
sessionId - the id of the HTTP session, if any
items.translation: sessionId - 如果有，则为 HTTP 会话的 ID。

items.source: userName - the name of the user that was associated with the request, if any (usually the UserPrincipal)
items.translation: userName - 与请求关联的用户名称（如果有，通常是 UserPrincipal）

items.source: processingTimeMillis - the processing time of the request in milliseconds
failureCause - the cause of failure, if any
toString in class EventObject
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `EventObject` 中
